Aperture v3.2 anti-epistemicide donor corpus is a separately named six-artifact research family; do not identify it with four Zenodo URLs absent exact full-text matching.

TD613 Π(s)=t_inst−t_op and SignalRupture NLF=t_IRE−t_PDS use different clock anchors.

Version 1.2: SRC epoch src-20260824-p2-001 was directly inspected; all four SignalRupture PDF text derivatives and their capture/parent SHA-256 identities were recovered. #20076214 is Paper II and #20076616 is Paper III by the original texts; umbrella shorthand labels differ from exact titles. Independent dataset/simulation validation remains unearned.

Uploaded source editions document that the four-paper Conspiracy Shield corpus is formalized as a conceptual, measurement, generative and forecasting research program; the attached papers alone do not demonstrate all claimed simulations, numerical regularities or successful forecasts.
Cross-paper labels in the umbrella are editorial descriptions and differ from standalone formal titles; exact variants and their distinct document loci are preserved without silent normalization.
Paper III is the third SignalRupture Conspiracy Shield publication, not the proposed third TD613 foundational sister dissertation.

Author-reported Paper I validation prevalence, Paper II fitted model assertions, Paper III simulation results and the umbrella decision rule must carry evidentiary statuses and require separate replication.

Edition 1.4 retains Tawanna C. Miller’s direct-collaboration account for the epistemicide framework separately from publication bylines, source-document inspection, later Aperture extensions and independent empirical validation.
